heroLede: Unhurried check-ups, gentle kids’ visits and same-week emergencies in Sellwood, Portland. Prices up front, no lectures.
heroImageAlt: A young girl smiling up at her dentist from the chair while her mother sits beside her.
heroCardText: 8 am to 1 pm, for school kids and nine-to-fivers.
manifesto: Most people put off the dentist because the last one made them feel rushed or judged. Linden is built around the opposite. We book longer appointments, explain before we touch anything, stop when you raise a hand, and tell you the price before you agree to it.
visitTitle: Your first visit, start to finish.
visitLede: Five steps, about an hour. Here is exactly what happens, so nothing comes as a surprise.

visitSteps.title: Book in two minutes
visitSteps.body: Online or by phone. Tick the box if you are nervous and we book you double time.

visitSteps.title: Arrive to a quiet room
visitSteps.body: No TV blaring, no clipboard pile. June has your paperwork ready and the kettle on.
visitSteps.imageAlt: A calm, sunlit treatment room with a single dental chair.

visitSteps.title: Talk before anything
visitSteps.body: You stay sitting up while we talk through what is bothering you and what you want from the visit.
visitSteps.imageAlt: A dentist chatting with a patient before her exam.

visitSteps.title: A gentle check-up
visitSteps.body: We explain each step before it happens and stop the moment you raise your hand.
visitSteps.imageAlt: A child smiling at her teeth in a hand mirror.

visitSteps.title: Leave with a written plan
visitSteps.body: What we found, what can wait, and what anything would cost. No surprises on the bill.
visitSteps.imageAlt: A dentist walking a patient through her x-rays on a tablet.

teamTitle: The same four faces, every visit.
teamText: No rotating locums. The people who know your teeth are the people who see you.
journalTitle: Straight answers, written by the team.
findImageAlt: A patient checking in at the wooden front desk with a smiling coordinator.
insurance: Most PPO plans, plus Oregon Health Plan for kids. No insurance? Membership is $29 a month.
parking: Free parking behind the building on SE 15th.
access: Step-free entrance and an accessible treatment room.
